Job Description:
• Provide administrative and clerical support to the team
• Assist general HR functions such as recruitment, maintain and update employee records, personnel filing and database administration.
• Ensure daily operations are running smoothly by coordinating with internal and external parties
• Participate in any ad hoc tasks as assigned

 Requirements:
• Degree in Human Resources Management or a related discipline
• Year 2 & Year 3 university students are preferable
• Able to work independently and proactively
• Good command of both written and spoken English & Chinese
• Proficiency in MS Word, Excel & Chinese word processing
• Workday Day : Monday to Friday (3-4 days per week)
• Working Hour : 09:00 - 18:00 (4-8hrs per day)
• Immediate available is preferred

Responsibilities:
• To provide clerical support to administration duties
• To maintain the general filing system and file all correspondence
• Translate regular documents and act as a Japanese / Chinese interpreter
• Act as a communication channel between store operations and internal departments
• Perform as a part of operations team to provide advice and support to store operations
• To assists with and support other ad-hoc duties as assigned

 Requirements:
• University degree or above in any discipline
• Working experience with customer services is an advantage
• Excellent spoken and written Japanese / Mandarin / English
• Good telephone manner, interpersonal and organization skills
• Working Day : Prefer Tuesday & Wednesday
• Working Hour : 09:00 – 18:00 ( 4-8 hours per day )
• Immediate availability is preferred
